institution.name: Itjareng Vocational Training Centre
institution.founder: Lesotho National Association of the Physically Disabled (LNAPD)

programs.name: Metalwork & Welding
programs.description: Hands-on training in metal fabrication, welding techniques, and structural work. Students learn to create functional metal products for household and commercial use.

programs.name: Carpentry & Joinery
programs.description: Comprehensive woodworking training covering furniture making, joinery, and construction carpentry. Graduates can work independently or for construction firms.

programs.name: Leatherwork
programs.description: Traditional and modern leather craft including bags, shoes, belts and accessories. Products made by students are available for sale by special order.

programs.name: Sewing & Tailoring
programs.description: Garment construction, alterations, and fashion design. Students develop skills for self-employment or work in the textile industry.

programs.name: Agriculture
programs.description: Practical agricultural training including piggery, chicken breeding, and vegetable gardening. Equips students with food production skills for livelihood improvement.

programs.name: Computer Literacy
programs.description: Basic to intermediate computer skills including word processing, spreadsheets, and internet use to prepare students for modern workplaces.

programs.name: Literacy & Numeracy
programs.description: Foundation education in reading, writing, and mathematics. Ensures all students can engage fully with their vocational training and future employment.

programs.name: Sign Language
programs.description: Lesotho Sign Language instruction for hearing-impaired students and staff, promoting inclusive communication across the entire centre.
